cohort: The study involved 51 pregnant women with small-for-gestational-age (SGA) or late-onset fetal growth restriction (late-onset FGR) delivering at or beyond 37 weeks' gestation.
finding: Intra-abdominal umbilical vein (FIUV) diameter and FIUV/head circumference (HC) ratios were significantly smaller in fetuses that experienced distress and required emergency cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: The study found that a smaller FIUV diameter was associated with an increased need for emergency cesarean section due to fetal distress.
